Capabilities / Backstory

Think it through.
Bring it to life.

The story gives the work direction. Craft takes it all the way.

We can tackle a specific challenge or support a brand’s communication over time. We start by understanding what needs to change.

01

Brand & marketing strategy

Before a campaign comes a decision: what role should the brand play in people’s lives? We work on positioning, narrative and voice to give every piece a clear direction.

  • Diagnosis, audiences and value proposition
  • Positioning, narrative and tone of voice
  • Marketing plans and editorial strategy
  • Roadmaps, priorities and measurement
02

Content & campaigns

We turn strategy into stories, images and experiences. We develop campaigns and content with a consistent intent, even as the screen, length or language changes.

  • Branded content and storytelling
  • Digital campaigns
  • Design, illustration and motion
  • Editorial content
03

Social & digital experiences

Brands are also built through everyday interactions. We connect planning, content and community management with websites and digital experiences that keep the story moving.

  • Social strategy and management
  • Community management
  • Website design and development
  • Performance review and optimization
04

Writing & production

Writing runs through everything we do. We develop scripts and formats, plan production and guide audiovisual execution, editing and animation.

  • Script and format development
  • Audiovisual production
  • Animation and post-production
  • Original content development
How we work

A clear process.
An open conversation.

01

Listen

Understand the business, the audience and the question to solve.

02

Find

Define the idea, the point of view and the language that will sustain it.

03

Build

Write, design and produce, with clear reviews at each stage.

04

Learn

Review the response, capture what we learn and improve the next delivery.
